title: Local Origin of Hidden Symmetry in Rotating Spacetimes
summary: We show that, within a broad stationary-axisymmetric class, Kerr-type separability and hidden symmetry arise as a local consequence of the Einstein equations. Without assuming separability, algebraic speciality, Killing--Yano symmetry, or global boundary conditions, we analyze stationary and axisymmetric geometries in a locally non-rotating orthonormal frame and impose a minimal local equilibrium condition, namely the absence of mixed energy-momentum fluxes.
